heading: Featured security projects
description: Focused case studies from authorized labs, tools, and hands-on security assessment work.

items.title: Hospital Management System Security Assessment
items.shortDescription: Structured security assessment of a PHP-based Hospital Management System in an authorized, controlled testing environment.

caseStudy.environment: Authorized testing of a local, intentionally vulnerable PHP application—not a production hospital system.
caseStudy.approach: Mapped application areas, reviewed authentication, authorization and input handling, then manually validated observations using Burp Suite and browser tools. Findings were organized against OWASP guidance and prioritised with risk assessment.
caseStudy.outcome: Produced a structured assessment format covering evidence, impact, remediation recommendations, and reporting. Findings are not listed publicly because only documented, sanitized results should be shared.

items.title: WebSafeScan
items.shortDescription: Bash-based utility for initial web security checks: headers, TLS configuration, cookie attributes, and technology fingerprinting.

caseStudy.objective: Automate repeatable early-stage web security checks without replacing manual penetration testing.
features: Checks HTTP security headers, TLS and certificate configuration, cookie security attributes, and technologies exposed by a target.
caseStudy.implementation: The tool combines Bash with Curl, OpenSSL, SSLScan, and WhatWeb.
caseStudy.lessonsLearned: Automation is useful for coverage and consistency; results still require contextual review and manual validation before they are treated as security findings.

items.title: Custom Linux Privilege Escalation Lab
items.shortDescription: A self-created CTF machine for learning Linux enumeration, insecure configuration review, and privilege-escalation concepts safely.

caseStudy.environment: Self-created Linux CTF lab, designed exclusively for controlled learning.
caseStudy.objective: Practice methodical enumeration and identify insecure Linux configurations that can create a privilege-escalation path.
features: The lab explores permissions, sudo configuration, SUID binaries, capabilities, cron jobs, and service configuration, with defensive remediation considered alongside each concept.

items.title: Browser Workflow Automation Tool
items.shortDescription: Python desktop automation for browser and application-window workflow tasks.

caseStudy.implementation: Desktop workflow automation built with Python, PyAutoGUI, PyGetWindow, and the standard webbrowser module. It demonstrates controlled application-window interaction and repetitive task automation.

items.title: Cybersecurity Awareness Quiz
items.shortDescription: Interactive browser-based quiz covering core cybersecurity awareness concepts with local score tracking.

items.title: Weather Prediction System
items.shortDescription: Rainfall prediction application using historical weather data, preprocessing, model evaluation, and Flask integration.

caseStudy.implementation: Machine-learning web project using Python, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Flask, HTML, and CSS. The application uses historical weather data to support rainfall prediction and demonstrates data-preparation and model-integration workflows.
